active_calculation_at_startup: One original-method MP2 gradient in the second bounded Sella order0/internal chunk, after reuse of the last accepted v1 gradient.
next_action: Acknowledge completion/failure/deadline; replay actual native outputs, full-precision gradients and accepted trajectory. Audit last accepted force/energy progress, original fixed targets and chi, stereocenters, and sugar descriptors. Stop additional optimization on audited constrained stationarity; do not call it a minimum. Assess correspondence/curvature needs before any next stage. Further chunk only after evidence of progress/necessity and bounded admission. No automatic second fit or broader grid.
restart_policy: Use exact accepted geometry/gradient, keep the original reference targets for all32fixed atoms and the identical chi target. All evaluated trials and accepted checkpoints retained; optimizer Hessian/history not restorable.
storage_policy: All outputs/native scratch on mounted Archive. No existing-data move/delete.

final_descriptors_vs_original.interpretation: Historical geometric screening flags only; passing does not prove basin identity or global-minimum closure.

final_descriptors_vs_alternate_seed.interpretation: Historical geometric screening flags only; passing does not prove basin identity or global-minimum closure.

completed_chunk_audit.continuation_reason: Strong recent force reduction and stable native cost justify one more bounded chunk from the last accepted state. Reuse its full-precision gradient and exact original fixed/chi targets, with fresh optimizer history. Audit again at convergence or the allocation boundary.
completed_chunk_audit.alternatives: Do not repeat the seed gradient, lower electronic tolerances, fit to an unconverged point, expand the scan or compute an endpoint Hessian now. No optimizer Hessian restart was saved; retain exact native geometry/gradient and use the established Sella restart method.
completed_chunk_audit.interpretation: The alternate branch has an observed QM energy below the original reference under the same electronic model and fixed-core/chi conditions within recorded constraint tolerances. This is not a converged relative basin energy, a minimum certificate, a barrier, or proof of global basin closure.
